content_of_post_to_comment: I deactivated my Facebook and Instagram accounts. I was picking up the phone every hour every minute of the day. I was getting sucked in every time. It was harder and harder to put it down. I attempted to make my own content and kinda got old, quickly. I deactivated last night before going to sleep, someone was endlessly calling and texting me, that was the catalyst behind the decision, after I blocked this person I decided it might be a good idea to work on putting the phone down, and focusing on real life. I am still able to get in touch with family and friends. I think that matters more to me. I will slowly challenge myself more by keeping TV at a minimum. Maybe instead of using my computer at home, I go to the library instead to get out of the house. It's a weird feeling to think of an electronic device almost like a phantom appendage. I use it for everything. Now I will try to find other ways around it. Any support or suggestions you have would be greatly appreciated. Thanks.
